To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) regression models can accurately and efficiently predict performance and power for microarchitecture design space exploration, (2) performance and power models have distinct sources of accuracy, and (3) application-specific models maximize performance prediction accuracy while regional power models maximize power prediction accuracy.
regression modeling is an accurate and computationally efficient approach to predict microarchitectural application performance and power.

we propose regression modeling as a computationally efficient approach for accurate prediction of performance and power in a microarchitectural space, that we derive and validate models for performance and for power prediction, and that we show that the accuracy of these models can be improved by application-specific models and by regional power models that leverage only the most relevant design space samples.

the development and evaluation of statistical models that can predict microarchitectural power and performance.
